facts.fact: StackAdapt was named 'Overall Data Technology Solution of the Year' in the 6th annual Data Breakthrough Awards, according to the vendor's April 2025 press release.
facts.quote: has been named “Overall Data Technology Solution of the Year” in the [6 th annual Data Breakthrough Awards]

facts.fact: The press release is dated April 3, 2025, in Toronto.
According to the Data Breakthrough Awards organizers, this year's program attracted thousands of nominations from data-driven companies worldwide.
facts.quote: This year’s program attracted thousands of nominations from leading data-driven companies worldwide.

facts.fact: According to StackAdapt's own 'About' description, its platform is used by thousands of brands and agencies around the world (vendor claim, not independently verified).
facts.quote: StackAdapt is a multi-channel programmatic advertising platform used by thousands of brands and agencies around the world.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states it is rated the number 1 demand-side platform (DSP) on G2 (vendor-reported claim attributed to G2).
facts.quote: is rated [the number 1 demand-side platform](https://www.stackadapt.com/best-demand-side-platform-dsp) (DSP) on G2

facts.fact: The Data Breakthrough Awards cover categories such as DataOps, AI, Analytics, Business Intelligence, and Privacy.
facts.quote: The Data Breakthrough Awards highlight global innovators in categories such as DataOps, AI, Analytics, Business Intelligence, and Privacy.

facts.fact: Tech Breakthrough LLC states its recognition consists of opinions and should not be construed as statements of fact, and it does not endorse any vendor in its programs.
facts.quote: Tech Breakthrough LLC recognition consists of the opinions of the Tech Breakthrough LLC organization and should not be construed as statements of fact.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's Page Context AI lets users build a custom contextual strategy by entering in-context and out-of-context phrases to determine ad placements based on a publisher or site's content.
facts.quote: allowing users to build a custom contextual strategy by inputting in context and out of context phrases
